# يُسْلَنْطَحُ (yuslanṭaḥu) /jus.lan.tˤa.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْلَنْطَحَ (islanṭaḥa)
# يَسْلَنْطِحَ (yaslanṭiḥa) /jas.lan.tˤi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْل
